shots.title: Pin packageManager so a clean checkout installs and CI stops floating (#645)
shots.notes: packageManager pnpm@10.32.1 plus engines.pnpm >= 9. pnpm/action-setup reads the field, so CI and local converge instead of CI floating to latest.

shots.title: Run CI on pull requests that target a feature branch (#645)
shots.notes: pull_request branches ['**']. Stacked PRs #639 and #640 ran no CI at all while #638 ran the full suite — the PRs where a regression is easiest to miss.

shots.title: Stop claim-required gating every write with ask in adhoc mode (#643)

hazards.description: Two existing tests asserted the old contract, one named "emits ask output ... on adhoc ... writes" — precisely what #643 reports as wrong. Updated to the intended behaviour rather than worked around, which is the right call but worth noting: a test name can encode a bug as a requirement.

shots.notes: Advisory context in adhoc instead of ask/deny, deduped once per session. Sprint sessions still gate with ask.

conditions: All three Phase 56 sprints were implemented on one branch rather than three stacked branches; the Phase 55 stack was already three deep.
yardage_book_updates: parseArgs in the claim and release commands only captures --key=value; bare flags must be read from argv, as --force already is.
GUARD_RELEVANCE.suppressInAdhoc controls whether a sprint-workflow guard runs in adhoc mode; gating strength is separate and lives in the guard.
course_management_notes: A test name can encode a defect as a requirement. When a fix breaks a test whose name states the wrong behaviour, the test is the thing to change.
